semanticDecisions: the lanes keep the A14 absence proofs (prepared facts mayContain, a UTF-16 needle never in a Latin-1 haystack) before any bulk read

the window is 4096 units in the haystack coder, or twice the needle when the needle is longer, so every window holds at least one full candidate; consecutive windows overlap by the needle length minus one

the stock static String.indexOf/lastIndexOf(byte[], coder, count, needle, from) run over each window: they already resolve the coder mix (UTF-16 haystack with a Latin-1 needle) and take the intrinsics
the bulk lane is taken at every length: measured 3x faster than the per-unit loop already at 64 units (a window allocation is cheaper than 64 owner dispatches)
a window that could not fit a byte array (over a billion UTF-16 units) falls back to the former per-unit loop, now in M3String
